glosses: A formal written request made by an individual or a group of people to a sovereign or political authority, often containing many signatures, soliciting some grace, right, mercy, or the redress of some wrong or grievance.

examples.text: We're looking to get 10,000 people to sign the petition to have the bird colony given legal protection.

glosses: A formal written application made to a magistrate or court for an order or a suit for divorce.
A prayer or supplication, especially of which is formal or humble and made to a deity, a sovereign, or an authority.

examples.text: a petition to God for courage and strength
A house of prayer and petition for thy people.

glosses: To make a petition to (a sovereign or political authority).

examples.text: The villagers petitioned the council to demolish the dangerous building.

The company, appreciating the crippling affect ^([sic]) that this scheme will have on its activities unless the railway is diverted, has petitioned against the North Wales Hydro-Electric Power Bill at present before the House of Lords.
